item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Clicking Kasper in the Dock during sign-in or setup brings that window forward instead of skipping ahead to the main window.
  • Softer shadows on the cards in Kasper's window and Settings.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Kasper's orb, agents and cards move out of the way when a notification appears or you open Notification Center, then move back.
  • Result cards and Kasper's replies line up with the middle of the orb.
  • Timers can be set in seconds, like "set a timer for 30 seconds".

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Explanations now ring the exact part Kasper is talking about, like a single symbol or term in a formula, with new glass bubbles, glowing pointers and smooth fades.
  • Guides check the screen before saying a task is done, start faster, read clearly in dark apps like Photoshop, and pause when the window you're working in closes, then pick up again when it's back.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Kasper works in the background whenever it can. Apps you mention only come to the front when Kasper has to click or type in them, or when it's showing you how to do something.
  • Apple Music now plays songs from the Apple Music catalog in the background, without opening the Music window.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description: • Playing music no longer takes over your screen. Spotify and Apple Music start in the background, and if Kasper ever has to click in the app, it returns you to what you were doing and hides the player again.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Apple Music plays the song you ask for much more reliably: it plays straight from your library when the song is there, and otherwise opens the exact song from the Apple Music catalog.
  • Setup is shorter: apps ask for permission the normal macOS way the first time Kasper uses them.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Setup now asks up front for permission to control Finder and System Events, so emptying the Trash, moving files and changing settings work without surprise pop-ups.
  • Full Disk Access is no longer part of setup. It stays available in Settings, Permissions, for the rare cases that need it.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• New optional Full Disk Access step in setup and in Settings, Permissions, with a button that opens the right page in System Settings.
  • When macOS blocks Kasper from a protected folder, Kasper now tells you and opens Full Disk Access settings instead of failing quietly.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Fixes "empty the Trash" being skipped and Kasper saying the Trash was empty when it wasn't.
  • Kasper's reply and result cards now use the same glass as agent cards and are narrower.
  • Kasper only listens while you hold Command Esc. It no longer keeps listening on its own after answering.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description: • When ChatGPT's voice isn't available, Kasper's backup Mac voice is now a natural male voice instead of the system default.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Fixes Allow Contacts and Allow Calendar and Reminders doing nothing. If access was turned off before, Kasper now opens the right page in System Settings.
  • The sign-in screen links to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• Integrations like Notion, Slack, GitHub and Google are marked as coming soon while they are being set up.
  • Kasper now checks for updates when it starts and every hour, so fixes reach you sooner.

item.title: Kasper 1.0
item.description:
• First public release of Kasper for macOS.
  • Hold ⌘ Esc and speak: Kasper answers, does things on your Mac, or shows you where to click.
  • Sign in with Google, then connect your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan or an OpenAI API key. Kasper itself is free.
  • Kasper now updates itself automatically.
